evidence: Committed static baseline: solution/solve.sh only refuses an in-use DB, copies the committed solution/app into /app (cp -a, same as template solve.sh) and deletes any stale app.db/-wal/-shm, so every install starts from the same bytes and seeds afresh; no download, npm install, build or generation step. package.json pins express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1 (exact). The frozen solution/ tree is byte-identical to the project worktree (diff -r clean) and its 12 file hashes equal raw-evidence-index matching_source_files. index.html loads only same-origin /styles.css and /js/*.js; the only fetch() in public/js/app.js:29 is same-origin API. Deterministic seeding: src/db.js:71 reads seed_data.json from beside the module (byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json, sha256 22df2a00...60bd); seedIfEmpty (db.js:122-147) inserts users/jobs/applications with the seed's fixed ids, applications with a fixed created_at '2026-06-15T09:00:00Z' (db.js:136), messages/notes with their seed created_at values, and read markers resolved by seed-array index (ids[app][read_count-1], db.js:143-144), so autoincrement message ids and unread/seen figures are identical every run; reseeding never happens on restart (db.js:123). Seed per-thread message timestamps are strictly increasing and unique (APP-101 120 msgs, APP-201 3, APP-301 2, APP-302 1), so id order == time order and the graded 30-per-page paging of Noor's thread (120 -> 30 shown, 90 earlier) is fixed. No Math.random anywhere; ordering everywhere is by position,id / id / created_at,id (index.js:173,182,189,199) — no tie depends on time. Non-pinned runtime values: index.js:59 now() = wall-clock ISO for runtime-created sessions/activity/messages/notes/actions/application created_at, and index.js:60 uid() = crypto.randomBytes(3) ids for jobs/applications created during grading, plus random session tokens (index.js:88). None of these is a pinned or graded value: the brief and hireops_rules.md define no fixed clock and no time-based rule (grep for clock/date/time/ago in instruction.md, rules, integration.md, all prompts and judge.toml finds only timeout and candidate words), criteria grade order/positions/counts/wording, and judges create and locate their own jobs by unique title, not id. Runtime evidence: scripted golden run (workspace.json, hash-verified) on the frozen solution bytes with a real restart passed its 18 groups including thread paging 30-at-a-time and unread counts; this is not a configured judge run or Oracle score, and none is claimed.
counterexample: Tried: (1) a weak reference that reseeded on boot or derived seed ids/created_at from Date/random would move unread counts, paging and the Noor thread — not present (db.js:123 guard, fixed seed values). (2) Wall-clock created_at on new applications: candidate list orders by created_at,id (index.js:173); with a container clock earlier than 2026-06-15 a newly linked Tomas application would sort before seeded ones, but no criterion grades candidate-list order, so no graded figure moves. (3) A 3-byte random job/application id could collide (~1 in 16.7M per pair) causing a 500 on create — latent only (P3-level), not a pinned value. (4) A conforming alternative using its own ids/timestamps is not penalised by this row since nothing graded depends on the reference's values.
run_verdict: PARTIAL — static inspection plus one hash-bound scripted golden run (with restart) confirm deterministic seeding and graded seed-derived figures; no repeated fresh-install comparison run and no configured judge/Oracle run exist, but neither is required to establish this row.
